title: Joel Gascoigne (Buffer CEO) reading-update thread — 'one of the most important books for new and growing businesses in a long time'
summary: Gascoigne founded Buffer and is its CEO. He posted a thread on X on his progress through the book.
blockquote:
An update on reading so far:

- Incorruptible is undoubtedly one of the most important books for new and growing businesses in a long time

- I'm in awe of @ericries' storytelling abilities and the way he weaves together examples and cautionary tales to drive points home.
